run_SglFunction: run an SglFunction with sampling parameters like max_new_tokens and temperature
bind_SglFunction_arguments: bind arguments to an SglFunction to create a new function with preset values
run_batch_SglFunction: run an SglFunction with a batch of keyword argument dictionaries
create_SglGen_expression: create an SglGen expression that calls the model to generate text with optional constraints
convert_SglSamplingParams_to_openai: convert SglSamplingParams to OpenAI API compatible keyword arguments
